definition: A large payment given to a senior employee when they leave a company.
example: The outgoing chief executive received a golden handshake worth two years' salary.

fr.definition: Somme importante versée à un cadre supérieur qui quitte l'entreprise.

de.definition: Eine hohe Zahlung an eine Führungskraft beim Ausscheiden.

es.definition: Pago elevado a un alto directivo cuando deja la empresa.

pt.definition: Pagamento elevado a um alto quadro quando sai da empresa.

definition: A contract term stopping someone from working for a rival for a set time.
example: Her non-compete clause prevents her from joining another bank for twelve months.

fr.definition: Clause qui interdit de travailler pour un concurrent pendant un certain temps.

de.definition: Vertragsklausel, die für eine Zeit die Arbeit bei der Konkurrenz verbietet.

es.definition: Cláusula que prohíbe trabajar para la competencia durante un tiempo.

pt.definition: Cláusula que proíbe trabalhar para a concorrência durante algum tempo.

definition: An employee who reveals illegal or dishonest activity inside an organisation.
example: The fraud only came to light after a whistleblower contacted the regulator.

fr.definition: Personne qui révèle des pratiques illégales dans son organisation.

de.definition: Jemand, der illegale Vorgänge in seiner Organisation aufdeckt.

es.definition: Persona que revela actividades ilegales dentro de su organización.

pt.definition: Pessoa que revela atividades ilegais dentro da sua organização.

definition: A legal duty to act in the best interests of another person or organisation.
example: Board members have a fiduciary duty to protect the interests of shareholders.

fr.definition: Obligation légale d'agir dans l'intérêt d'autrui.

de.definition: Die rechtliche Pflicht, im Interesse eines anderen zu handeln.

es.definition: Obligación legal de actuar en interés de otra persona.

pt.definition: Obrigação legal de agir no interesse de outra pessoa.

definition: A period when a departing employee is paid but told not to work.
example: He spent three months on garden leave before starting at the rival firm.

fr.definition: Période où un salarié qui part est payé mais ne travaille plus.

de.definition: Zeit, in der ein ausscheidender Mitarbeiter bezahlt, aber nicht beschäftigt wird.

es.word: el permiso retribuido previo a la salida
es.definition: Periodo en que un empleado que se va cobra pero no trabaja.

pt.definition: Período em que um trabalhador de saída recebe mas não trabalha.

definition: To approach someone working elsewhere and offer them a job.
example: She was headhunted by a consultancy after her conference presentation.

fr.definition: Recruter une personne qui travaille ailleurs en l'approchant directement.

de.definition: Jemanden, der woanders arbeitet, gezielt für eine Stelle ansprechen.

es.definition: Captar a alguien que trabaja en otra empresa.

pt.definition: Abordar alguém que trabalha noutra empresa para lhe oferecer emprego.

definition: Behaviour at work serious enough to justify immediate dismissal.
example: Sharing client data without permission was treated as gross misconduct.

fr.definition: Comportement au travail qui justifie un licenciement immédiat.

de.definition: Verhalten am Arbeitsplatz, das eine fristlose Kündigung rechtfertigt.

es.definition: Conducta laboral que justifica el despido inmediato.

pt.definition: Comportamento no trabalho que justifica o despedimento imediato.

definition: The share of a company that a person or firm owns.
example: The investor took a twenty percent equity stake in the start-up.

fr.definition: Part d'une entreprise détenue par une personne ou une société.

de.definition: Der Anteil an einem Unternehmen, den jemand besitzt.

es.definition: Parte de una empresa que posee una persona o compañía.

pt.definition: Parte de uma empresa detida por uma pessoa ou sociedade.

definition: Do something badly or cheaply to save time or money.
example: The builders cut corners, and the roof started leaking within a year.

fr.definition: Faire quelque chose mal pour gagner du temps ou de l'argent.

de.definition: Etwas schlampig machen, um Zeit oder Geld zu sparen.

es.definition: Hacer algo mal para ahorrar tiempo o dinero.

pt.word: fazer as coisas em cima do joelho
pt.definition: Fazer algo mal para poupar tempo ou dinheiro.

definition: Act too soon, before the right moment.
example: They jumped the gun by announcing the deal before the contract was signed.

fr.definition: Agir trop tôt, avant le bon moment.

de.definition: Zu früh handeln, vor dem richtigen Zeitpunkt.

es.definition: Actuar demasiado pronto.

pt.word: pôr o carro à frente dos bois
pt.definition: Agir cedo demais, antes do momento certo.

definition: Having to start planning again because an idea failed.
example: The prototype failed every test, so it's back to the drawing board.

fr.definition: Il faut tout recommencer car l'idée a échoué.

de.definition: Man muss neu planen, weil eine Idee gescheitert ist.

es.definition: Tener que planificar de nuevo porque una idea fracasó.

pt.definition: Ter de planear de novo porque uma ideia falhou.

definition: A win that costs so much it is almost a defeat.
example: The company won the lawsuit, but the legal fees made it a Pyrrhic victory.

fr.definition: Victoire obtenue à un prix si élevé qu'elle ressemble à une défaite.

de.definition: Ein Sieg, der so viel kostet, dass er fast eine Niederlage ist.

es.definition: Victoria que cuesta tanto que casi es una derrota.

pt.definition: Vitória que custa tanto que quase é uma derrota.

definition: A weak point that can cause failure.
example: Poor customer service has become the airline's Achilles' heel.

fr.definition: Point faible qui peut causer l'échec.

de.definition: Eine Schwachstelle, die zum Scheitern führen kann.

es.definition: Punto débil que puede causar el fracaso.

pt.definition: Ponto fraco que pode causar o fracasso.

definition: Something that distracts attention from the real issue.
example: The debate about the logo was a red herring; the real problem was the price.

fr.definition: Élément qui détourne l'attention du vrai problème.

de.definition: Etwas, das vom eigentlichen Problem ablenkt.

es.definition: Algo que desvía la atención del problema real.

pt.definition: Algo que desvia a atenção do problema real.

definition: Pretending not to want something because you cannot have it.
example: He says the promotion wasn't worth it, but that's just sour grapes.

fr.definition: Dénigrer ce qu'on ne peut pas obtenir.

de.definition: So tun, als wolle man nicht, was man nicht bekommen kann.

es.definition: Despreciar lo que no se puede conseguir.

pt.definition: Desdenhar o que não se consegue obter.

definition: A very difficult first experience of something new.
example: Her first week as a nurse, during a flu outbreak, was a baptism of fire.

fr.definition: Première expérience très difficile de quelque chose de nouveau.

de.definition: Eine sehr schwierige erste Erfahrung mit etwas Neuem.

es.definition: Primera experiencia muy difícil de algo nuevo.

pt.definition: Primeira experiência muito difícil de algo novo.

definition: A question that no longer matters or cannot be settled.
example: Whether we should have hired him is a moot point now that he has resigned.

fr.definition: Question qui n'a plus d'importance ou ne peut être tranchée.

de.definition: Eine Frage, die keine Rolle mehr spielt.

es.definition: Asunto que ya no importa o no se puede resolver.

pt.definition: Questão que já não interessa ou não se pode resolver.

definition: Criticise someone indirectly by praising them very weakly.
example: Calling his novel "perfectly readable" was damning it with faint praise.

fr.definition: Critiquer quelqu'un en le louant très faiblement.

de.definition: Jemanden indirekt kritisieren, indem man ihn nur schwach lobt.

es.definition: Criticar a alguien de forma indirecta con un elogio muy débil.

pt.definition: Criticar alguém de forma indireta com um elogio muito fraco.

definition: Stop trying because you are satisfied with past success.
example: After winning the award, the team didn't rest on their laurels.

fr.definition: Cesser de faire des efforts après un succès.

de.definition: Nach einem Erfolg keine Mühe mehr geben.

es.definition: Dejar de esforzarse tras un éxito.

pt.definition: Deixar de se esforçar depois de um sucesso.

definition: The study of human societies, cultures and how they develop.
example: She studied anthropology to understand how rituals shape community life.

fr.definition: Étude des sociétés humaines, de leurs cultures et de leur évolution.

de.definition: Die Wissenschaft von menschlichen Gesellschaften und Kulturen.

es.definition: Estudio de las sociedades humanas, sus culturas y su evolución.

pt.definition: Estudo das sociedades humanas, das suas culturas e da sua evolução.

definition: Having several centres of power or activity rather than one.
example: The region developed as a polycentric network of small cities instead of one capital.

fr.definition: Qui a plusieurs centres de pouvoir ou d'activité.

de.definition: Mit mehreren Macht- oder Aktivitätszentren statt einem.

es.definition: Que tiene varios centros de poder o actividad.

pt.definition: Que tem vários centros de poder ou de atividade.

definition: Found everywhere, so common that people hardly notice it.
example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, even in remote mountain villages.

fr.definition: Présent partout, au point qu'on ne le remarque plus.

de.definition: Überall vorhanden, so dass man es kaum noch bemerkt.

es.definition: Presente en todas partes, tan común que apenas se nota.

pt.definition: Presente em todo o lado, tão comum que quase não se nota.

definition: The part of philosophy that asks how we know things and what counts as knowledge.
example: Her thesis examines the epistemology of scientific models in climate research.

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie la nature de la connaissance.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der fragt, wie wir etwas wissen.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia cómo conocemos las cosas.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda como conhecemos as coisas.

definition: Strong control or influence of one group or country over others.
example: The essay traces the cultural hegemony of Hollywood after the Second World War.

fr.definition: Domination d'un groupe ou d'un pays sur les autres.

de.definition: Die Vorherrschaft einer Gruppe oder eines Landes über andere.

es.definition: Dominio de un grupo o país sobre otros.

pt.definition: Domínio de um grupo ou país sobre os outros.

definition: A simple rule of thumb that helps people make decisions quickly.
example: Shoppers often rely on a heuristic such as choosing the middle-priced option.

fr.definition: Règle simple qui aide à décider rapidement.

de.definition: Eine einfache Faustregel für schnelle Entscheidungen.

es.definition: Regla sencilla que ayuda a decidir con rapidez.

pt.definition: Regra simples que ajuda a decidir rapidamente.

definition: The part of philosophy that studies what exists and what kinds of things are real.
example: The debate turns on the ontology of numbers: do they exist independently of us?

fr.definition: Branche de la philosophie qui étudie ce qui existe.

de.definition: Teil der Philosophie, der untersucht, was existiert.

es.definition: Rama de la filosofía que estudia lo que existe.

pt.definition: Ramo da filosofia que estuda o que existe.

definition: Insisting that your beliefs are right and refusing to consider other views.
example: The reviewer found the author too dogmatic to engage with opposing evidence.

fr.definition: Qui impose ses idées sans accepter la discussion.

de.definition: Auf den eigenen Überzeugungen beharrend, ohne andere Ansichten zu prüfen.

es.definition: Que impone sus ideas sin aceptar otras opiniones.

pt.definition: Que impõe as suas ideias sem aceitar outras opiniões.

definition: Understood only by a small group with special knowledge.
example: The lecture was too esoteric for anyone outside the field of medieval law.

fr.definition: Compris seulement par un petit groupe de spécialistes.

de.definition: Nur für einen kleinen Kreis von Eingeweihten verständlich.

es.definition: Comprensible solo para un pequeño grupo de especialistas.

pt.definition: Compreensível apenas para um pequeno grupo de especialistas.

definition: A system for sorting things into ordered groups.
example: The researchers proposed a new taxonomy of online misinformation.

fr.definition: Système de classement en catégories ordonnées.

de.definition: Ein System zur Einteilung in geordnete Gruppen.

es.definition: Sistema para clasificar cosas en grupos ordenados.

pt.definition: Sistema para classificar coisas em grupos ordenados.

definition: Something that belongs to a different period of time from the one it appears in.
example: A wristwatch in a film about ancient Rome is an obvious anachronism.

fr.definition: Élément qui n'appartient pas à l'époque où il apparaît.

de.definition: Etwas, das nicht in die Zeit passt, in der es vorkommt.

es.definition: Algo que no corresponde a la época en que aparece.

pt.definition: Algo que não pertence à época em que aparece.

definition: A basic statement accepted as true without needing proof.
example: The model rests on the axiom that people act in their own interest.

fr.definition: Principe de base admis comme vrai sans démonstration.

de.definition: Ein Grundsatz, der ohne Beweis als wahr gilt.

es.definition: Principio básico que se acepta como verdadero sin prueba.

pt.definition: Princípio básico aceite como verdadeiro sem prova.

definition: Clear, logical and convincing.
example: She presented a cogent case for investing in public transport.

fr.definition: Clair, logique et persuasif.

de.definition: Klar, logisch und überzeugend.

es.definition: Claro, lógico y persuasivo.

pt.definition: Claro, lógico e persuasivo.

definition: Meant to teach, sometimes in a way that feels like lecturing.
example: The novel's didactic tone makes its moral lessons feel heavy-handed.

fr.definition: Destiné à enseigner, parfois de façon moralisatrice.

de.definition: Belehrend, manchmal auf eine aufdringliche Art.

es.definition: Pensado para enseñar, a veces de forma sermoneadora.

pt.definition: Destinado a ensinar, por vezes de forma moralista.

definition: Having or showing great knowledge from long study.
example: The professor's erudite introduction referred to sources in six languages.

fr.definition: Qui a de vastes connaissances acquises par l'étude.

de.definition: Mit großem Wissen aus langem Studium.

es.definition: Que tiene grandes conocimientos adquiridos por el estudio.

pt.definition: Que tem grandes conhecimentos adquiridos pelo estudo.

definition: Unusual and typical of one particular person or thing.
example: His idiosyncratic spelling made the old letters easy to identify.

fr.definition: Propre à une personne et assez inhabituel.

de.definition: Ungewöhnlich und typisch für eine bestimmte Person.

es.definition: Peculiar y propio de una persona concreta.

pt.definition: Peculiar e próprio de uma pessoa concreta.

definition: Strange because it does not fit with its surroundings.
example: A glass tower looks incongruous among the old stone houses.

fr.definition: Étrange parce qu'il ne va pas avec ce qui l'entoure.

de.definition: Seltsam, weil es nicht zur Umgebung passt.

es.definition: Extraño porque no encaja con lo que lo rodea.

pt.definition: Estranho por não combinar com o que o rodeia.

definition: Just starting to exist and not yet fully developed.
example: The country's nascent tech industry still depends on foreign investment.

fr.definition: Qui commence à exister et n'est pas encore développé.

de.definition: Gerade entstehend und noch nicht voll entwickelt.

es.definition: Que empieza a existir y aún no está desarrollado.

pt.definition: Que começa a existir e ainda não está desenvolvido.

definition: To make something deliberately unclear or hard to understand.
example: The report uses technical language to obfuscate its weak results.

fr.definition: Rendre volontairement quelque chose confus.

de.definition: Etwas absichtlich unklar machen.

es.definition: Hacer algo confuso a propósito.

pt.definition: Tornar algo confuso de propósito.

definition: A shortage of something that is needed.
example: The paucity of reliable records makes the period hard to reconstruct.

fr.definition: Manque de quelque chose de nécessaire.

de.definition: Ein Fehlen von etwas, das gebraucht wird.

es.definition: Falta de algo necesario.

pt.definition: Falta de algo necessário.

definition: Harmful in a gradual way that is hard to notice.
example: The study describes the pernicious effect of constant notifications on attention.

fr.definition: Nuisible de façon lente et discrète.

de.definition: Auf schleichende, kaum merkliche Weise schädlich.

es.definition: Dañino de forma gradual y poco visible.

pt.definition: Nocivo de forma gradual e pouco visível.

definition: Based on a particular idea or condition being true.
example: The plan is predicated on the assumption that interest rates will stay low.

fr.definition: Qui repose sur une idée ou une condition.

de.definition: Auf einer bestimmten Annahme oder Bedingung aufgebaut.

es.definition: Que se apoya en una idea o condición.

pt.definition: Que se baseia numa ideia ou condição.

definition: Being the most typical example of something.
example: The small café with mismatched chairs is the quintessential student hangout.

fr.definition: Qui représente l'exemple le plus typique.

de.definition: Das typischste Beispiel für etwas.

es.definition: Que es el ejemplo más típico de algo.

pt.definition: Que é o exemplo mais típico de algo.

definition: Making a complex issue seem too simple.
example: Blaming the crisis on one politician is a reductive explanation.

fr.definition: Qui simplifie trop une question complexe.

de.definition: Eine komplexe Frage zu stark vereinfachend.

es.definition: Que simplifica demasiado un asunto complejo.

pt.definition: Que simplifica demasiado uma questão complexa.

definition: False, though it may look genuine or logical.
example: The article draws a spurious link between chocolate and exam success.

fr.definition: Faux, même s'il semble vrai ou logique.

de.definition: Falsch, auch wenn es echt oder logisch wirkt.

es.definition: Falso, aunque parezca auténtico o lógico.

pt.definition: Falso, embora pareça autêntico ou lógico.

definition: Understood without being said aloud.
example: There was a tacit agreement that nobody would mention the budget.

fr.definition: Compris sans être dit.

de.definition: Verstanden, ohne ausgesprochen zu werden.

es.definition: Que se entiende sin decirse.

pt.definition: Que se entende sem ser dito.

definition: The idea of explaining things by the purpose they seem to serve.
example: Critics reject the teleology of stories that present history as steady progress.

fr.definition: Explication des choses par leur but.

de.definition: Die Erklärung von Dingen durch ihren Zweck.

es.definition: Explicación de las cosas por su finalidad.

pt.definition: Explicação das coisas pela sua finalidade.

definition: The quality of being true or accurate.
example: Journalists checked the veracity of the video before publishing it.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui est vrai ou exact.

de.definition: Die Eigenschaft, wahr oder genau zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de ser verdadero o exacto.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que é verdadeiro ou exato.

definition: The general mood and ideas typical of a particular period.
example: The album captured the anxious zeitgeist of the early pandemic.

fr.definition: État d'esprit typique d'une époque.

de.definition: Die typische Stimmung und Denkweise einer Epoche.

es.definition: Ambiente e ideas típicos de un periodo.

pt.definition: Ambiente e ideias típicos de um período.

definition: The study of how texts and meanings are interpreted.
example: The seminar applies hermeneutics to legal texts as well as literature.

fr.definition: Étude de l'interprétation des textes.

de.definition: Die Lehre vom Auslegen von Texten.

es.definition: Estudio de la interpretación de los textos.

pt.definition: Estudo da interpretação dos textos.

definition: Made up of parts that are very different from each other.
example: The sample was heterogeneous, including students, retirees and shift workers.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très différents.

de.definition: Aus sehr unterschiedlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy distintos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito diferentes.

definition: Made up of parts that are all very similar.
example: The survey group was too homogeneous to reflect the wider population.

fr.definition: Composé d'éléments très semblables.

de.definition: Aus sehr ähnlichen Teilen bestehend.

es.definition: Formado por elementos muy parecidos.

pt.definition: Formado por elementos muito semelhantes.

definition: So closely connected that the parts cannot be separated.
example: In her view, economic and environmental questions are inextricable.

fr.definition: Si lié qu'on ne peut pas le séparer.

de.definition: So eng verbunden, dass man es nicht trennen kann.

es.definition: Tan unido que no se puede separar.

pt.definition: Tão ligado que não se pode separar.

definition: Very difficult to solve or deal with.
example: Housing shortages have proved intractable despite decades of reform.

fr.definition: Très difficile à résoudre.

de.definition: Sehr schwer zu lösen oder zu bewältigen.

es.definition: Muy difícil de resolver.

pt.definition: Muito difícil de resolver.

definition: To increase quickly in number.
example: Fact-checking websites proliferated after the election.

fr.definition: Se multiplier rapidement.

de.definition: Schnell an Zahl zunehmen.

es.definition: Multiplicarse con rapidez.

pt.definition: Multiplicar-se rapidamente.

definition: Reaching the truth by setting opposing ideas against each other.
example: The book follows a dialectical structure, moving from thesis to counterargument.

fr.definition: Qui avance en confrontant des idées opposées.

de.definition: Durch die Gegenüberstellung gegensätzlicher Ideen zur Wahrheit gelangend.

es.definition: Que busca la verdad enfrentando ideas opuestas.

pt.definition: Que procura a verdade confrontando ideias opostas.

definition: Clever arguments that sound good but are actually false.
example: The minister's defence was dismissed as mere sophistry.

fr.definition: Raisonnements habiles mais trompeurs.

de.definition: Geschickte, aber irreführende Argumente.

es.definition: Argumentos ingeniosos pero engañosos.

pt.definition: Argumentos engenhosos mas enganadores.

definition: The quality of seeming true or real.
example: Detailed street names give the novel a strong sense of verisimilitude.

fr.definition: Qualité de ce qui paraît vrai ou réel.

de.definition: Der Eindruck, wahr oder echt zu sein.

es.definition: Cualidad de parecer verdadero o real.

pt.definition: Qualidade do que parece verdadeiro ou real.

definition: Very suitable for the situation.
example: The speaker ended with an apposite quotation about patience.

fr.definition: Parfaitement adapté à la situation.

de.definition: Genau passend zur Situation.

es.definition: Muy adecuado a la situación.

pt.definition: Muito adequado à situação.

definition: To limit something within clear boundaries.
example: The committee's powers are tightly circumscribed by the constitution.

fr.definition: Limiter à l'intérieur de bornes précises.

de.definition: Etwas innerhalb klarer Grenzen halten.

es.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteras claras.

pt.definition: Limitar algo dentro de fronteiras claras.

definition: Based on observation or experiment rather than theory alone.
example: The claim sounds reasonable, but there is little empirical evidence for it.

fr.definition: Fondé sur l'observation ou l'expérience.

de.definition: Auf Beobachtung oder Experiment beruhend.

es.definition: Basado en la observación o la experiencia.

pt.definition: Baseado na observação ou na experiência.

definition: To make a bad situation even worse.
example: Cutting bus routes would exacerbate isolation in rural areas.

fr.definition: Rendre une mauvaise situation encore pire.

de.definition: Eine schlechte Lage noch schlimmer machen.

es.definition: Empeorar una situación que ya era mala.

pt.definition: Tornar pior uma situação que já era má.

definition: To make something harmful less serious.
example: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of summer heat in cities.

fr.definition: Rendre quelque chose de nuisible moins grave.

de.definition: Etwas Schädliches weniger schlimm machen.

es.definition: Hacer que algo dañino sea menos grave.

pt.definition: Tornar algo prejudicial menos grave.

definition: Never having happened before.
example: The storm caused unprecedented damage to the coastline.

fr.definition: Qui n'est jamais arrivé auparavant.

de.definition: So noch nie da gewesen.

es.definition: Que nunca había ocurrido antes.

pt.definition: Que nunca tinha acontecido antes.

definition: Reasonable and likely to be true.
example: Her explanation for the delay sounded plausible, so nobody questioned it.

fr.definition: Raisonnable et probablement vrai.

de.definition: Vernünftig und wahrscheinlich wahr.

es.definition: Razonable y probablemente cierto.

pt.definition: Razoável e provavelmente verdadeiro.

definition: Dealing with real, important matters rather than details.
example: The meeting produced no substantive changes to the proposal.

fr.definition: Qui touche aux questions importantes, pas aux détails.

de.definition: Wesentliche, wichtige Punkte betreffend.

es.definition: Que trata asuntos importantes y no detalles.

pt.definition: Que trata de questões importantes e não de pormenores.

definition: Dealing with problems in a practical way rather than by theory.
example: The council took a pragmatic approach and fixed the worst roads first.

fr.definition: Qui traite les problèmes de façon concrète.

de.definition: Probleme praktisch statt theoretisch angehend.

es.definition: Que resuelve los problemas de forma práctica.

pt.definition: Que resolve os problemas de forma prática.

definition: Having mixed feelings about something.
example: Many residents feel ambivalent about the new stadium near their homes.

fr.definition: Qui ressent des sentiments contradictoires.

de.definition: Mit gemischten Gefühlen gegenüber etwas.

es.definition: Que tiene sentimientos contradictorios.

pt.definition: Que tem sentimentos contraditórios.

definition: Based on chance or personal choice rather than reason.
example: The cut-off age of 25 seems arbitrary and is not explained in the report.

fr.definition: Qui dépend du hasard ou d'un choix personnel.

de.definition: Auf Zufall oder persönlicher Laune statt auf Gründen beruhend.

es.definition: Que depende del azar o de un capricho, no de razones.

pt.definition: Que depende do acaso ou de um capricho, e não de razões.

definition: A difference between things that should be the same.
example: Auditors found a discrepancy between the invoices and the bank records.

fr.definition: Différence entre des choses qui devraient concorder.

de.definition: Ein Unterschied zwischen Dingen, die übereinstimmen sollten.

es.definition: Diferencia entre cosas que deberían coincidir.

pt.definition: Diferença entre coisas que deviam coincidir.

definition: To work together so the result is greater than each part alone.
example: The two teams synergized well, combining design skills with technical knowledge.

fr.definition: Coopérer pour obtenir plus que chacun seul.

de.definition: So zusammenarbeiten, dass das Ergebnis größer ist als die Teile.

es.definition: Colaborar para lograr más de lo que cada parte lograría sola.

pt.definition: Colaborar para conseguir mais do que cada parte sozinha.

definition: A standard used to measure or compare performance.
example: Last year's sales figures serve as the benchmark for this quarter.

fr.definition: Norme qui sert à mesurer ou comparer des résultats.

de.definition: Ein Standard, an dem Leistung gemessen wird.

es.definition: Estándar para medir o comparar resultados.

pt.definition: Padrão usado para medir ou comparar resultados.

definition: Able to grow larger without losing efficiency.
example: Investors want a scalable business that can expand to new markets quickly.

fr.definition: Capable de grandir sans perdre en efficacité.

de.definition: Wachstumsfähig, ohne an Effizienz zu verlieren.

es.definition: Capaz de crecer sin perder eficacia.

pt.definition: Capaz de crescer sem perder eficiência.

definition: The process of helping new employees settle into a job.
example: Good onboarding helps new staff feel confident in their first month.

fr.definition: Processus d'accueil des nouveaux salariés.

de.definition: Das Einführen neuer Mitarbeiter in ihre Arbeit.

es.definition: Proceso para integrar a los nuevos empleados.

pt.definition: Processo de acolhimento de novos colaboradores.

definition: A point where work slows down because too much must pass through it.
example: Approval by a single manager became a bottleneck for every project.

fr.definition: Point où le travail ralentit à cause d'un blocage.

de.definition: Eine Stelle, an der sich Arbeit staut.

es.definition: Punto donde el trabajo se atasca.

pt.definition: Ponto onde o trabalho abranda por causa de um bloqueio.

definition: To encourage people to do something by offering a reward.
example: The company incentivizes cycling to work with a monthly bonus.

fr.definition: Encourager en offrant une récompense.

de.definition: Durch eine Belohnung zu etwas ermutigen.

es.definition: Animar a hacer algo ofreciendo una recompensa.

pt.definition: Encorajar a fazer algo oferecendo uma recompensa.

definition: To pay another company to do work instead of doing it yourself.
example: The firm outsources its IT support to a company abroad.

fr.definition: Confier un travail à une autre entreprise.

de.definition: Arbeit an eine andere Firma vergeben.

es.definition: Encargar un trabajo a otra empresa.

pt.definition: Entregar um trabalho a outra empresa.

definition: Official authority or permission to carry out a task.
example: The new board has a clear mandate to cut costs.

fr.definition: Autorisation officielle de mener une mission.

de.definition: Offizieller Auftrag oder Befugnis für eine Aufgabe.

es.definition: Autoridad oficial para llevar a cabo una tarea.

pt.definition: Autorização oficial para cumprir uma tarefa.

definition: The rate at which employees leave and have to be replaced.
example: High staff turnover makes it hard to keep experienced people.

fr.word: le taux de rotation du personnel
fr.definition: Rythme auquel les salariés partent et sont remplacés.

de.definition: Die Rate, mit der Mitarbeiter gehen und ersetzt werden.

es.definition: Ritmo al que los empleados se van y se sustituyen.

pt.definition: Ritmo a que os trabalhadores saem e são substituídos.

definition: Openness about decisions and information, so others can see what happens.
example: Staff asked for more transparency about how bonuses are calculated.

fr.definition: Ouverture sur les décisions et les informations.

de.definition: Offenheit bei Entscheidungen und Informationen.

es.definition: Apertura sobre decisiones e información.

pt.definition: Abertura sobre decisões e informações.

definition: To find a way of earning money from something.
example: The app has millions of users but has not yet found a way to monetize them.

fr.definition: Trouver un moyen de gagner de l'argent avec quelque chose.

de.definition: Einen Weg finden, mit etwas Geld zu verdienen.

es.definition: Encontrar una forma de ganar dinero con algo.

pt.definition: Encontrar maneira de ganhar dinheiro com algo.

definition: The area of work that a person or group is responsible for.
example: Customer complaints fall outside the remit of the finance team.

fr.definition: Domaine dont une personne ou un groupe est responsable.

de.definition: Der Bereich, für den jemand verantwortlich ist.

es.definition: Área de la que es responsable una persona o grupo.

pt.definition: Área pela qual uma pessoa ou grupo é responsável.

definition: Related to government or company money, especially taxes and spending.
example: The fiscal year ends in March, so budgets are set in February.

fr.definition: Relatif aux finances, surtout aux impôts et dépenses.

de.definition: Die öffentlichen Finanzen, Steuern und Ausgaben betreffend.

es.definition: Relativo a las finanzas, sobre todo impuestos y gastos.

pt.definition: Relativo às finanças, sobretudo impostos e despesas.

definition: To spread the cost of something over a period of time.
example: The company will amortize the new software over five years.

fr.definition: Répartir un coût sur une certaine période.

de.definition: Kosten über einen Zeitraum verteilen.

es.definition: Repartir un coste a lo largo de un periodo.

pt.definition: Distribuir um custo ao longo de um período.

definition: Settling a dispute by letting a neutral person make the decision.
example: The pay dispute went to arbitration after talks broke down.

fr.definition: Règlement d'un conflit par une personne neutre.

de.definition: Beilegung eines Streits durch eine neutrale Person.

es.definition: Resolución de un conflicto por una persona neutral.

pt.definition: Resolução de um conflito por uma pessoa neutra.

definition: How easily a company can get cash to pay its bills.
example: The retailer faced a liquidity crisis after sales collapsed.

fr.definition: Capacité d'une entreprise à disposer d'argent pour payer.

de.definition: Wie leicht ein Unternehmen Bargeld für Rechnungen hat.

es.definition: Capacidad de una empresa para disponer de dinero.

pt.definition: Capacidade de uma empresa dispor de dinheiro.

definition: The process of buying goods and services for an organisation.
example: Procurement rules require three quotes for any contract over ten thousand euros.

fr.definition: Processus d'achat de biens et services pour une organisation.

de.definition: Der Einkauf von Waren und Dienstleistungen für eine Organisation.

es.definition: Proceso de compra de bienes y servicios de una organización.

pt.definition: Processo de compra de bens e serviços de uma organização.

definition: A gradual fall in staff numbers as people leave and are not replaced.
example: The firm reduced its workforce through attrition rather than layoffs.

fr.definition: Baisse du personnel par départs non remplacés.

de.definition: Allmählicher Personalrückgang, weil Stellen nicht nachbesetzt werden.

es.definition: Disminución gradual del personal por salidas no cubiertas.

pt.definition: Diminuição gradual do pessoal por saídas não substituídas.

definition: Conditions that make progress or growth more difficult.
example: Rising energy prices are a major headwind for manufacturers this year.

fr.definition: Conditions qui freinent la progression.

de.definition: Umstände, die Fortschritt oder Wachstum bremsen.

es.definition: Condiciones que dificultan el avance.

pt.definition: Condições que dificultam o progresso.

definition: How an action looks to the public, regardless of its real effect.
example: Giving bonuses during layoffs would be terrible optics.

fr.definition: Façon dont une action est perçue par le public.

de.definition: Wie eine Handlung in der Öffentlichkeit wirkt.

es.definition: Cómo percibe el público una acción.

pt.definition: Como o público percebe uma ação.

definition: A personal reason for wanting something to happen, often for profit.
example: As a shareholder, he has a vested interest in the merger going ahead.

fr.definition: Raison personnelle de vouloir un résultat, souvent financière.

de.definition: Ein persönlicher, oft finanzieller Grund für ein bestimmtes Ergebnis.

es.definition: Motivo personal, a menudo económico, para desear algo.

pt.definition: Razão pessoal, muitas vezes financeira, para querer algo.

definition: Money already spent that cannot be recovered.
example: Don't continue the project just because of the sunk cost; judge its future value.

fr.definition: Argent déjà dépensé qu'on ne peut pas récupérer.

de.definition: Bereits ausgegebenes Geld, das nicht zurückkommt.

es.definition: Dinero ya gastado que no se puede recuperar.

pt.definition: Dinheiro já gasto que não se pode recuperar.

definition: To use a situation to gain an advantage.
example: The brand capitalized on the viral video by launching a matching product.

fr.definition: Profiter d'une situation pour en tirer avantage.

de.definition: Eine Situation zum eigenen Vorteil nutzen.

es.definition: Aprovechar una situación para obtener ventaja.

pt.definition: Aproveitar uma situação para obter vantagem.

definition: To combine things into one stronger, more efficient unit.
example: The bank plans to consolidate its three regional offices into one.

fr.definition: Réunir plusieurs éléments en un ensemble plus efficace.

de.definition: Mehrere Teile zu einer stärkeren Einheit verbinden.

es.definition: Unir varias partes en una unidad más sólida.

pt.definition: Juntar várias partes numa unidade mais sólida.

definition: To stop growing or improving.
example: Wages have stagnated while living costs keep rising.

fr.definition: Cesser de progresser.

de.definition: Aufhören zu wachsen oder sich zu verbessern.

es.definition: Dejar de crecer o mejorar.

pt.definition: Deixar de crescer ou melhorar.

definition: Very careful and paying attention to every detail.
example: She keeps meticulous notes of every expense during a trip.

fr.definition: Très soigneux et attentif au moindre détail.

de.definition: Sehr sorgfältig und genau bis ins Detail.

es.definition: Muy cuidadoso y atento a cada detalle.

pt.definition: Muito cuidadoso e atento a cada pormenor.

definition: Careful to spend very little money.
example: Living a frugal life let them save for a house in five years.

fr.definition: Qui dépense très peu d'argent.

de.definition: Darauf bedacht, sehr wenig Geld auszugeben.

es.definition: Que gasta muy poco dinero.

pt.definition: Que gasta muito pouco dinheiro.

definition: Honest and direct, even about uncomfortable things.
example: I appreciated his candid feedback on my first draft.

fr.definition: Honnête et direct, même sur des sujets gênants.

de.definition: Ehrlich und direkt, auch bei unangenehmen Themen.

es.definition: Sincero y directo, incluso sobre temas incómodos.

pt.definition: Honesto e direto, mesmo sobre temas incómodos.

definition: Able to recover quickly after difficulties.
example: Children are often more resilient than adults expect after a move.

fr.definition: Capable de se remettre vite des difficultés.

de.definition: Fähig, sich nach Schwierigkeiten schnell zu erholen.

es.definition: Capaz de recuperarse pronto tras las dificultades.

pt.definition: Capaz de recuperar depressa depois de dificuldades.

definition: To keep delaying something you should do.
example: I always procrastinate when I have to fill in tax forms.

fr.definition: Remettre sans cesse à plus tard ce qu'on doit faire.

de.definition: Etwas, das man tun sollte, immer wieder aufschieben.

es.definition: Aplazar una y otra vez algo que se debe hacer.

pt.definition: Adiar constantemente algo que se deve fazer.

definition: To waste money, time or a chance in a careless way.
example: He squandered his savings on gadgets he never used.

fr.definition: Dépenser ou perdre sans réfléchir de l'argent ou une chance.

de.definition: Geld, Zeit oder eine Chance leichtsinnig vergeuden.

es.definition: Malgastar dinero, tiempo o una oportunidad.

pt.definition: Desperdiçar dinheiro, tempo ou uma oportunidade.

definition: Often bad-tempered and ready to argue.
example: Our cantankerous neighbour complains about every parked car.

fr.definition: Souvent de mauvaise humeur et prêt à se disputer.

de.definition: Oft schlecht gelaunt und auf Streit aus.

es.definition: Que se enfada con facilidad y busca discusión.

pt.definition: Que está muitas vezes mal-humorado e pronto a discutir.

definition: Full of energy, excitement and cheerfulness.
example: The ebullient host greeted every guest with a joke.

fr.definition: Plein d'énergie et de bonne humeur.

de.definition: Voller Energie und Begeisterung.

es.definition: Lleno de energía y alegría.

pt.definition: Cheio de energia e alegria.

definition: Very concerned about small details, cleanliness or accuracy.
example: He is so fastidious that he irons his socks.

fr.definition: Très attentif aux détails, à la propreté ou à la précision.

de.definition: Übertrieben genau bei Details oder Sauberkeit.

es.definition: Muy exigente con los detalles o la limpieza.

pt.definition: Muito exigente com pormenores ou limpeza.

definition: Enjoying the company of other people.
example: Being gregarious, she quickly made friends in her new city.

fr.definition: Qui aime la compagnie des autres.

de.definition: Gern in der Gesellschaft anderer Menschen.

es.definition: Que disfruta de la compañía de otros.

pt.definition: Que gosta da companhia dos outros.

definition: Acting quickly without thinking about the results.
example: In an impetuous moment, he quit his job by text message.

fr.definition: Qui agit vite sans réfléchir aux conséquences.

de.definition: Schnell handelnd, ohne an die Folgen zu denken.

es.definition: Que actúa deprisa sin pensar en las consecuencias.

pt.definition: Que age depressa sem pensar nas consequências.

definition: Showing little effort or enthusiasm.
example: His lackadaisical attitude to deadlines annoyed the whole team.

fr.definition: Qui montre peu d'effort ou d'enthousiasme.

de.definition: Mit wenig Mühe oder Begeisterung.

es.definition: Que muestra poco esfuerzo o entusiasmo.

pt.definition: Que mostra pouco esforço ou entusiasmo.

definition: Calm and seeming not to care or worry.
example: She gave a nonchalant shrug when asked about the exam results.

fr.definition: Calme et apparemment indifférent.

de.definition: Ruhig und scheinbar unbekümmert.

es.definition: Tranquilo y aparentemente indiferente.

pt.definition: Calmo e aparentemente indiferente.

definition: Too eager to please or obey others.
example: The obsequious waiter kept refilling our glasses after every sip.

fr.definition: Trop empressé à plaire ou à obéir.

de.definition: Übertrieben bemüht, anderen zu gefallen.

es.definition: Demasiado deseoso de agradar u obedecer.

pt.definition: Demasiado ansioso por agradar ou obedecer.

definition: Behaving in a childish, bad-tempered way when things do not go your way.
example: He gave a petulant reply after losing the argument.

fr.definition: Qui se comporte de façon capricieuse quand il n'obtient pas ce qu'il veut.

de.definition: Kindisch schlecht gelaunt, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

es.definition: Que se enfada como un niño cuando no consigue lo que quiere.

pt.definition: Que se amua como uma criança quando não consegue o que quer.

definition: Complaining in a weak, annoyed way.
example: The querulous voice on the phone demanded to speak to the manager.

fr.definition: Qui se plaint d'un ton irrité.

de.definition: Auf gereizte Weise ständig klagend.

es.definition: Que se queja en tono irritado.

pt.definition: Que se queixa em tom irritado.

definition: Positive and hopeful, especially in a difficult situation.
example: Despite the delays, the organisers remain sanguine about opening on time.

fr.definition: Positif et confiant, surtout face aux difficultés.

de.definition: Positiv und hoffnungsvoll, besonders in schwierigen Lagen.

es.definition: Positivo y confiado, sobre todo ante dificultades.

pt.definition: Positivo e confiante, sobretudo perante dificuldades.

definition: The luck of finding something good without looking for it.
example: By pure serendipity, I met my future business partner on a delayed train.

fr.definition: Chance de trouver quelque chose de bien sans le chercher.

de.definition: Das Glück, etwas Gutes zu finden, ohne es zu suchen.

es.definition: Suerte de encontrar algo bueno sin buscarlo.

pt.definition: Sorte de encontrar algo bom sem o procurar.

definition: Done secretly because it would not be approved.
example: She took a surreptitious glance at her phone during the meeting.

fr.definition: Fait en secret parce que ce ne serait pas approuvé.

de.definition: Im Verborgenen getan, weil es nicht erlaubt wäre.

es.definition: Hecho a escondidas porque no estaría permitido.

pt.definition: Feito às escondidas por não ser permitido.

definition: Fear or worry about something that is going to happen.
example: With some trepidation, he opened the letter from the tax office.

fr.definition: Crainte de ce qui va arriver.

de.definition: Angst oder Sorge vor etwas Bevorstehendem.

es.definition: Miedo o preocupación por algo que va a ocurrir.

pt.definition: Medo ou preocupação com algo que vai acontecer.

definition: Felt through another person's experiences rather than your own.
example: Grandparents often get vicarious pleasure from their grandchildren's travels.

fr.definition: Ressenti à travers l'expérience de quelqu'un d'autre.

de.definition: Durch die Erfahrungen eines anderen erlebt.

es.definition: Vivido a través de las experiencias de otra persona.

pt.definition: Vivido através das experiências de outra pessoa.

definition: Playful and unusual in a charming way.
example: The café is full of whimsical details, like teacups hanging from the ceiling.

fr.definition: Ludique et original de façon charmante.

de.definition: Auf charmante Weise ungewöhnlich und fantasievoll.

es.definition: Juguetón y original de manera encantadora.

pt.definition: Brincalhão e original de forma encantadora.

definition: Slightly sad while thinking about something you miss or cannot have.
example: He gave a wistful smile as he looked at old holiday photos.

fr.definition: Un peu triste en pensant à ce qu'on regrette.

de.definition: Leicht traurig beim Gedanken an etwas Vergangenes.

es.definition: Algo triste al pensar en lo que se echa de menos.

pt.definition: Um pouco triste ao pensar no que se tem saudades.

definition: Showing great energy and enthusiasm for a belief or task.
example: A zealous volunteer checked every ticket twice.

fr.definition: Plein d'ardeur pour une cause ou une tâche.

de.definition: Mit großem Einsatz und Begeisterung für eine Sache.

es.definition: Que muestra gran entusiasmo por una causa o tarea.

pt.definition: Que mostra grande empenho numa causa ou tarefa.

definition: Generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or someone who has lost.
example: The winner was magnanimous and praised her opponent's performance.

fr.definition: Généreux et indulgent, surtout envers un adversaire.

de.definition: Großzügig und nachsichtig, besonders gegenüber einem Gegner.

es.definition: Generoso e indulgente, sobre todo con un rival.

pt.definition: Generoso e indulgente, sobretudo com um rival.
